answer: Give every newcomer a saffron badge that only unlocks small, low-value jobs. After several epochs of peer-graded work with no disputes, the badge matures into jade, opening larger payouts. A relic account with years of clean history cannot simply be sold, because the badge tracks behavior, not just the key — a buyer who behaves differently loses the tier within one epoch. Sybils can mint endless saffron identities, but they cannot fast-forward the slow, graded climb to jade, so farming stays unprofitable.
